notes: Only the satellite part of the score (built-up growth, night-light trend) is tested; OpenStreetMap signals have no historical data here.
All features use years up to 2020; outcomes use 2020 to 2025.
'Grew' means top-quartile built-up gain within the city. A lift of 1.0 means no better than choosing areas at random.
Confidence intervals come from a cluster bootstrap over coarser H3 cells; they are approximate.
Areas that grew are not the same as places where a business succeeds.

sensitivity.description: Same method with a gap year so the signal and the outcome share no data: scored on 2017-2019, outcome measured 2021-2025. Guards against noise in the as-of year pushing the signal and the outcome in opposite directions (regression to the mean).
